text: 中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理丁薛祥4日在符拉迪沃斯托克同俄罗斯副总理诺瓦克共同主持中俄能源合作委员会第二十三次会议。
text_en: Ding Xuexiang, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, co-chaired the 23rd meeting of the China-Russia Energy Cooperation Committee in Vladivostok on the 4th with Russian Deputy Prime Minister Novak.
